# Archived dependency

This is SymbolPicker at the exact revision recorded by the original Kyo 1.0.3 source: `201402a21c37a2c96c41e0b20724764eab1b5d35` ("added highlights").

The former dependency URL, `Aeastr/NeoSymbolPicker`, is unavailable. The same commit was recovered through the [upstream fork network](https://github.com/xnth97/SymbolPicker/commit/201402a21c37a2c96c41e0b20724764eab1b5d35) and included here without source changes. Its MIT license and original notices are preserved. This provenance note is the only added file inside the dependency snapshot.
